description: This Java source file defines a custom servlet filter 'TenantAwareAuthenticationFilter' that extends Spring's OncePerRequestFilter. It intercepts HTTP requests to resolve tenant identification from JWT tokens or request parameters, sets the tenant context for the current thread, and ensures cleanup after processing. The filter plays a role in multi-tenant authentication within the application.

classes.name: TenantAwareAuthenticationFilter
classes.description: Custom filter for tenant-aware authentication handling, extracting tenant info from JWT tokens or request parameters and setting the tenant context.

methods.name: doFilterInternal
methods.description: Overrides the method to process each HTTP request, parse tenant info from JWT or parameters, set the tenant context, and ensure cleanup.
